provenance: Synthetic hackathon scenario. All operational records and quantities are fictional.
plan_basis: Approved before shift. Targets and measured quantities are cumulative within the day for each activity.

records.text: Dry at shift start, 5 °C. Earthworks crew: one operator and two groundworkers. Drainage crew: three installers. Kerb crew: two installers.
Keep the north haul road clear for excavation traffic. Logistics coordinator to confirm the east gate arrangement by 14:00 today.
North trench. Excavator standing since ten. The haul road is blocked by stacked pallets. I can't see whose pallets they are.
The replacement crates should arrive around 13:30. I will confirm once the driver is on site.
Noon reading. Sixty-five cubic metres excavated today in the north trench. Still waiting for the haul road.
Please correct my noon reading. Seventy-five cubic metres, not sixty-five. The missed load left before ten. The road is still blocked.
Two pipe sections in the east laydown area have chipped sockets. Both tagged and set aside before installation. Supplier asked to inspect.
Haul road cleared and the excavator restarted at 13:20. Logging that time from the operator's call.
Replacement crates signed in at the east gate at 13:40.
East gate confirmation is still outstanding. Logistics coordinator to send the updated routing sketch by 15:30 today; this replaces the 14:00 deadline.
Routing sketch sent to the crews at 15:32. East gate arrangement confirmed.
Haulier mentioned a possible standby charge for this morning. No hours, rate or invoice supplied.
North trench final shift quantity from the signed load tally: 148 cubic metres excavated today. Project completion impact has not been assessed.
East drain: 36 metres installed today. The two damaged sections remain segregated pending supplier inspection.
South kerb line set out and installation under way. Measured length to follow tomorrow.
